channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Vietnam AI law takes effect, first in Southeast Asia
item.description: A law regulating artificial intelligence went into effect in Vietnam on Sunday, making it the first country in Southeast Asia with a comprehensive framework on the booming technology.

item.title: Man City move within two points of leaders Arsenal, Liverpool thrash West Ham
item.description: MANCHESTER, England - Manchester City are breathing down Arsenal's necks in a Premier League title race that is heating up, pulling within two points of the leaders with a 1-0 win at Leeds United on Saturday.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City urges telecom giants to explore 6G trials
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City has called on Vietnam’s three largest telecommunications groups, including Viettel, VNPT, and MobiFone, to research and develop sixth-generation (6G) mobile technology in 2026 and coordinate a pilot deployment in a designated area of the city.

item.title: Vietnam urges restraint as US-Israel-Iran conflict escalates
item.description: Vietnam has expressed deep concern over the conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran in the Middle East, calling on all parties to show the utmost restraint, cease all escalatory actions, and respect countries' sovereignty, according to the Vietnamese Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Japanese box-office phenomenon Kokuho set for release in Vietnam next week
item.description: Blockbuster film 'Kokuho' will make its debut in Vietnam on March 6 after topping over 20 billion yen (US$128 million) in Japan.

item.title: Vietnamese paragliders take to the skies to relieve stress, test limits
item.description: Paragliding is drawing a growing number of enthusiasts in Vietnam seeking stress relief and personal challenges, with local clubs expanding their flying sites and participants ranging from young professionals to people with physical disabilities.

item.title: What English proficiency tests are really measuring in Vietnam
item.description: The weeks after an English proficiency test often feel suspended. Students move through classes, part-time jobs, and daily routines while quietly tracking when results will be released.

item.title: More strikes aimed at Iran after US, Israeli assault kills supreme leader
item.description: DUBAI/JERUSALEM/WASHINGTON - Israel said it had launched another wave of strikes on Iran on Sunday, as Iranians faced uncertainty after the killing of their supreme leader in U.S. and Israeli attacks that threatened to destabilize the wider Middle East.

item.title: 4 Vietnamese honored at 2026 Study UK Alumni Awards
item.description: Four Vietnamese people were honored at the 2026 Study UK Alumni Awards in Vietnam, organized by the British Council in Hanoi on Saturday night.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City leader moves to scale back public events on Le Loi Boulevard
item.description: Chairman of the Ho Chi Minh City People’s Committee Nguyen Van Duoc has called for a sharp reduction, or potentially a complete suspension, of events on Le Loi Boulevard, citing concerns over traffic congestion and noise pollution in the city’s downtown area.
